subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept these third-party action upgrades after a CI/security owner verifies the Codex Action v1.11 contract and obtains redacted evidence from the credentialed workflow paths?
rationale: The change modifies pinned code executed with repository and service credentials; the necessary upstream Codex contract inspection and real after-fix workflow proof are not present in the PR evidence.

options.title: Verify then merge
options.body: Inspect the upgraded action contracts and attach redacted successful workflow evidence for the Codex, GitHub App-token, Docker, and relevant release paths before merging.

options.title: Defer the batch
options.body: Pause this broad action-update batch until a CI/security owner can review and validate the upgraded trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Verify then merge
recommendation.body: Inspect the upgraded action contracts and attach redacted successful workflow evidence for the Codex, GitHub App-token, Docker, and relevant release paths before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: These owners can evaluate the credential scopes and exercise the affected workflows without exposing secrets.
